summary.title: Fundamental-Anchored Multimodal Filing Alpha
summary.thesis: A stable fundamental anchor can bound noisy modality risk while a regime-gated MoE contributes text and market residual information.
summary.universe: Prior-month top-300 liquid reviewed US equities

methodology.target: 20-session beta-adjusted return from first tradable open
methodology.split: Expanding 2023/2024 model development; hash-frozen test from 2025; labels mature before every boundary
methodology.model: Fundamental-Anchored MoE h=64 dropout=0.10 gate=1.00 moe=0.25
methodology.portfolio: Daily event-driven 50/50 long-short with gross, net, beta, industry, and name constraints
methodology.costs: 10/25/50 bps transaction-cost scenarios plus 2% annual short borrow
limitations: Free IEX bars cover one venue rather than the consolidated SIP tape.
Historical identifier mapping and delisting coverage remain imperfect.
Historical borrow availability and realized borrow fees are unavailable.
Daily adjusted bars cannot reproduce intraday execution slippage.
Historical results do not establish future alpha.
